items.title: AI Experience 2.0
items.description: An upgrade to the existing Matric Mastery AI tutoring experience.
details: Image attachment and image-based question support, conditional on approved vision capability.
Voice input and optional spoken responses.
Improved mathematical and structured answer presentation.
items.notes: Vision remains disabled unless the required model approval and technical compatibility checks are completed.

items.title: Premium AI Interface Polish
items.description: A dedicated frontend refinement to improve the speed, responsiveness and smoothness of the existing AI workspace.
details: Reduced layout shifts and unnecessary re-renders.
items.notes: This is a frontend-focused improvement. The existing AI model and Cloudflare Worker are protected.

items.title: Continuous Platform Improvements
items.description: Ongoing quality, accessibility, and study-resource maintenance across the platform.

items.title: AI Text-Only Maintenance Update
items.description: Temporarily disabled image upload controls across the AI chat interfaces behind a centralized frontend flag while preserving text-based tutoring, voice dictation, and Cloudflare Workers AI routing.
details: Hid image attachment buttons, file pickers, and preview cards behind AI_IMAGE_INPUT_ENABLED.
Enforced frontend submission protection so stale image payloads cannot be sent.
Updated composer placeholder and Website Guide accuracy for text-based questions.

items.title: Dedicated /ai Tutoring Workspace & Workers AI Routing
items.description: Launched the distraction-free /ai workspace connected to the deployed Cloudflare Worker (@cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct-fast) with English and Urdu RTL math rendering.
details: Centered conversation workspace with curated Class 9–10 starter prompts.
Student-friendly HTTP 429 rate-limit, network, and retry error handling.
Local-only conversation storage with JSON session export.
